clips.title: The story
paras: Tucked along the western edge of Stormwind City between Cathedral Square and the Mage Quarter, the Park is a lush sanctuary of greenery and quiet reflection. Devoted to nature and leisure amidst the bustling stone capital, it serves as the primary haven for visiting night elves and houses the only druid trainers in the Eastern Kingdoms.

While the rest of Stormwind is dominated by cobbled walkways, towering limestone ramparts, and crowded market stalls, the Park offers a tranquil breath of wilderness. Originally established as a quiet place of recreation for the city's populace, it naturally transformed into an enclave for night elf emissaries and travelers arriving from across the Great Sea. Sheltered beneath shaded canopies and surrounding a central Moonwell, the district brings a sliver of Kalimdor's sacred glades into the heart of the human kingdom.
